tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and video background. Dark is the brand default for every video, thumbnail and listing image.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Bottom of the ground gradient and letterbox areas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles, platforms and price cards on ground.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Top stop of a card gradient; hovered or focused tiles.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, table rules, platform edges when not lit.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, numbers and body text on ground or surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, kickers, captions, secondary numbers. Passes 4.5:1 on ground and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Signal Orange: the brand colour. Button fills, the Co in the wordmark, the recommended price, glow and the connecting beam. As a fill, put ground-dark ink on it.

tokens.name: signal-text
tokens.usage: Orange used as text or thin strokes. Swaps to a darker orange on Paper so it keeps 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill.

tokens.name: ledger
tokens.usage: Ledger Green: profit, Healthy status, positive deltas.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Losing money, negative profit, struck-through old prices. A state colour: keep it small.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Below target status and review flags.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Price tags and receipts drawn as physical objects in scenes; always carries ground-dark ink.

tokens.name: kraft
tokens.usage: Parcel boxes in 3D scenes and the warm relief block on the cover.

tokens.name: coin
tokens.usage: Coins in 3D scenes only (metallic material), never UI.

tokens.name: engine-communicate
tokens.usage: Engine 01 Communicate (Customer Response Bank): its platform edge and label accent.

tokens.name: engine-resolve
tokens.usage: Engine 02 Resolve (Refund & Dispute Manager): its platform edge and label accent.

tokens.name: engine-profit
tokens.usage: Engine 03 Know your profit (Profit Pilot).

tokens.name: engine-automate
tokens.usage: Engine 04 Automate (AI Assistant).

tokens.name: block-deep
tokens.usage: Deep slab on the cover and large graphic fields that must read against ground in both themes.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Pill padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between scene elements.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding inside a frame.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Outer margin of a 1080px frame.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Background grid pitch; outer margin of a 2000px listing image is 2x this.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags, cube faces, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles in tilted grids.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, price cards, video frames.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large listing-image cards at 2000px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status badges, buttons, CTA pills.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Every card floating over ground; the depth that makes flat tiles feel 3D.

tokens.name: shadow-tile
tokens.usage: Small tiles inside a tilted grid.

tokens.name: glow-signal
tokens.usage: The one glowing thing per frame: the recommended price, the beam or the core.
